title: Research: one reset lowers PR1537's prefix bound from 4195 to 3932 (no new kappa)
body:
The fixed 53-child dirty echo in PR #1537 can keep its complete **2,114 ADD + 120 SCALE** invoice while reducing the maximum prefix row-L1 norm from **4,195 to 3,932**. Reset after child 52, then execute child 53 as a singleton. Both complete directions restore every dirty coordinate. This needs one fewer magnitude bit under the same conservative power-of-two envelope, and lowers the forward address-travel score by 12.

**Status: scoped recursive-interface construction and finite optimum; no new kappa or selected-supplier adoption.**

This answers Sagar Thakrar's explicit intermediate-reset question for the pinned PR1537 fixture. An exact 1,431-edge interval graph covers all **2^52 contiguous partitions**, with accumulated output and both echo directions included. Its 31-point cost/growth frontier proves that cap **3,932** is the least cap retaining the full 260-operation saving, while any feasible cap below **788** permits no arithmetic saving. At cap 2,047, the 28+25 partition costs 2,330 operations. The seed-selected cap 255 retains the eager 2,494-operation bill.

Only `research/unipotent-reset-cuts-seed57/` is added. It contains the written reduction and complete recurrence, all interval evidence, Bellman lower-bound potentials and attaining paths, exact words and resource counts, pinned predecessor sources, local claim, overlap receipt and failure controls. The fixed child order and binary-return alphabet are essential; no global circuit optimum, physical fixed-precision implementation or contracting multiplication recurrence is claimed.

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/unipotent-reset-cuts-seed57
```

Expected: `PASS_UNIPOTENT_RESET_CUTS`, four passing package tests, then `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE ... outcome=completed`.

Local validation passes on Python 3.12.13, including independent Fraction-column checks of all 31 frontier words (1,364 directed basis columns), all 511 smaller partitions (6,132 columns and 195 cap/tariff comparisons), ten semantic controls, actual source/certificate corruption rejection and full read-only relocation. Optimized Python 3.14 certificate replay, source pins, selected-record integrity and whitespace checks pass. The clean patch applies to refreshed main `c5108f0f68d482e5712a8e26a5978d47762dfc16`. Hosted CI is separate; no full selected cold replay or human/formal review is claimed.

Base: `ef5f39403610d231a0c27e8a6b4f08c10209bcd6`; OS assignment seed **57**, recursive interfaces. Predecessor PR1537 remains pinned at `407f00df6ca0bf86b455b5640f18ec2f62ee77b9`.
